questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: That it had similar culture to Denmark (Australia, Canada etc.)

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: The school did not seem to want to take care of the exchange students more so the international students (staying there for longer than a year). Coming over here was an odd experience and I hope they do more to invite exchange students to events and perhaps give them a mentor or the like.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: They had an introduction week which we (me and my roommates) attended, but no one could answer any of our questions and we were thrown left and right, so it was truly frustrating.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer:
I took a long time to find the right place. I would recommend going on AirBnB and
Kijiji.ca
(The Canadian equivalent to
DBA.dk
) and texting people (even if it's too expensive as many owners over here have multiple housing options to provide if out of budget)

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Living off campus can send you far away from campus and if you go south of the school you can end up in less appealing neighbourhoods that worth considering twice to live in.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer:
Uwo didn't seem to take my inquiry seriously. I told them (them being housing@
uwo.ca
- so the people set in motion to help us on the particular problem). Initially, I told them we were 3 people and our budget was $800 CAD each. Then she proceeded to send me a mail for 1 or 2 people as if I did not make an inquiry for 3 people. Places that were out of budget or were readily available to view myself (on
https://housing.uwo.ca/
) which I checked regularly. I didn't feel that they took me serious at all. Or listened to my inquiry. They just threw around arbitrary options.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: As mentioned previously, no one could answer questions and I was thrown around endlessly, so I ended up not changing anything and just 'going with the flow'.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I registered for courses at main campus and didn't have final confirmation a few days before the classes would begin.
